To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

monoamine oxidase B-deficient mice exhibit behavioral disinhibition and reduced anxiety-like behaviors, and these changes are accompanied by increased levels of the trace amine neurotransmitters β-phenylethyamine in brain regions involved in the regulation of these behaviors.
MAO B KO mouse exhibit decreased anxiety-like responses, increased behavioral disinhibition and higher PEA levels in the brain.
MAO B KO mouse exhibited significantly lower anxiety-related responses and shorter latency in engaging in risk-taking behaviors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of MAO-B on anxiety-like behavior.
the role of trace amine neurotransmitters, particularly PEA, in behavioral disinhibition and anxiety-like manifestations.
the role of the MAO B in the regulation of anxiety-like behaviors and behavioral disinhibition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MAO B KO leads to increased anxiety-like responses, and that the behavioral differences between MAO B KO and WT mice are likely due to the increased levels of PEA.
the MAOB-deficient mouse is an animal model of behavioral disinhibition, a trait that is associated with a variety of neuropsychiatric disorders.
MAO B KO animals exhibit a phenotype that resembles a mild form of ADHD.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MAO B is involved in the control of anxiety and behavioral disinhibition.
MAO B-deficient mice exhibit reduced behavioral anxiety and disinhibited behavior.
MAO B KO animals have a lower anxiety-like response and increased behavioral disinhibition.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the behavioral phenotype of the MAO B KO mouse is consistent with the behavioral phenotype of patients with low platelet MAO B activity, suggesting that the MAO B gene might be a good candidate for the genetic predisposition to behavioral disinhibition.
the MAOB gene may be an interesting target for the treatment of mood disorders and anxiety disorders.
MAO B KO mouse model is a useful tool for studying the role of PEA in the regulation of anxiety-like behaviors.
